retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, modernist graphic featuring a large, stylized hand silhouette with jagged edges and integrated geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bold, flat-color composition dominated by a large black hand silhouette with rough, torn edges. The hand is set against a diagonally split background of orange and red. The palm area contains fragmented, blocky typography that appears to be exploding or disintegrating, while the top features ultra-condensed sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: The black hand acts as a central silhouette that anchors the vibrant background colors.
The diagonal split between red and orange creates a sense of dynamic tension.
The fragmented typography in the palm mirrors the jagged, distressed edges of the hand silhouette.
coreInvariants: High-contrast flat color palette of red, orange, black, and white.
Jagged, 'torn paper' edges on all primary shapes.
Asymmetrical, dynamic composition with a strong diagonal axis.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive black hand silhouette occupies the majority of the frame, angled slightly to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The palm of the hand, where the most complex typographic fragmentation occurs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the fingers upward and outward, then drops to the palm's chaotic text, and finally to the clean text at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with saturated color blocks that interact with the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast between the black foreground and warm background.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: extremely high aspect ratio, thin strokes, rounded terminals.
Bottom text: heavy, blocky, fragmented into square and rectangular modules.
Intentional misalignment and 'shattered' appearance for the lower text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the palm are broken into geometric shards that suggest movement and destruction.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between clean, vertical elegance and chaotic, blocky fragmentation.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed verticality of the top text.
Required for the shattered, blocky effect in the palm.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a diagonal split background of vibrant red and orange. Overlay a large, black hand silhouette with jagged, torn-paper edges. Ensure the silhouette has a subtle paper-like texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place ultra-condensed white sans-serif text in the top left. In the palm area, arrange blocky, fragmented white and red letters that appear to be breaking apart into geometric shards.

verificationChecks: Is the hand silhouette's edge jagged and irregular?
Is the background a sharp diagonal split between red and orange?
Is the lower text fragmented into geometric blocks?
Is the top text ultra-condensed and clean?

mustRedesign: Do not use the exact signature in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'torn paper' texture on the black silhouette.
Ensure typography in the palm is sufficiently fragmented.
Verify the ultra-condensed nature of the top text.
Confirm the diagonal background split is sharp.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [subject silhouette] with [jagged edges] over a [diagonally split warm-tone background], featuring [fragmented geometric typography] in the center.
